mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for a metal-building condensation assessment?

acceptedAnswer.text: Select a general contractor with extensive experience constructing and retrofitting pre-engineered steel buildings. Ask whether they evaluate the entire building envelope, including vapor retarder integrity and thermal breaks, rather than just selling ventilation hardware. Choosing a contractor who understands structural steel assemblies ensures they can implement the necessary repairs, whether that involves repairing insulation facings, adding roof vents, or re-sealing wall transitions.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a licensed general contractor experienced in pre-engineered steel structures who evaluates thermal barriers and ventilation together rather than just pushing fans.
